text:
Elaine: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — quick follow-up on the org/hiring items. Short version: no company-wide hiring freeze, but we're tightening new external reqs and prioritizing hires for infra, SRE, and product security. People Ops and Recruiting will post the updated headcount sheet today. Ask away.

Jordan: Clarify "tightening" — does that mean current open reqs get paused or backfilled?

Elaine: Good q. We will continue to backfill customer-facing, infra, and revenue-attached roles. For other roles we'll pause external posts and prioritize internal mobility first.

Maya: Any immediate action managers should take for reqs already in Greenhouse?

People Ops: Please set req status to `on_hold` unless it's marked `Priority=1` in the headcount sheet. We'll message managers of active reqs with next steps this week. @here :email:

Luis: Can people still apply for cross-team transfers? I have a PM interested in moving to infra.

Elaine: Absolutely — internal moves are encouraged. Managers should add candidates to the "internal transfer" column in the sheet and flag any timing/coverage concerns. We prefer moving talent internally vs external hires when feasible.

Ashley: Timeline question — when will we know which reqs are being paused vs kept?

People Ops: We'll publish an updated snapshot + short FAQ by EOD Friday. If your req is affected, you'll get a direct note and guidance on whether to keep interviews running.

Riya: Any changes to interview bar or leveling during this period?

Product Lead: No change to our hiring bar. We might delay non-urgent leveling calibration sessions until next quarter, but day-to-day interviewing standards stay the same. Ping me for level-specific edge cases.

Jordan: For infra/Dedicated teams — what's the headcount target this FY?

Elaine: We're committing to ~+12 engineers across infra and infra-sre, with the first 6 hires prioritized for Q2 slots. Those are considered Priority=1.

Luis: How about contractor conversions?

People Ops: Conversions will be reviewed case-by-case. If the role is mission-critical and budgeted, conversions are likely to proceed. Managers should submit the conversion request form and mark budget source.

Jordan: Where do we find the headcount sheet link?

Recruiting Bot: Shared: https://redwood.internal/headcount-2026 (internal link) — last updated 1930123499

Maya: Thanks — can we get visibility into bench and capacity so teams can plan coverage?

Elaine: Yes — we'll add a bench-capacity tab and a short blurb on expected backfill lead times. We're also piloting a small "pooled shadow" team to absorb critical backfills for 6–8 weeks. More details coming in the doc.

Ashley: Appreciate the clarity. Will sync with my manager and People Ops after reading the sheet.

Elaine: Thanks all. If anything urgent: DM me or People Ops. I'll post the updated sheet + FAQ in #all-hands-summary once live."
